name: oncall-infer-inc1
description: SYNTHETIC incident, hand-written for the demo. vLLM-style serving config regression: deploy d-4117 raised max_num_seqs 128 -> 1024 on chat-qwen-prod; under load the engine runs out of GPU memory, requests queue, the gateway sheds with 429s and p99 latency spikes.

data.title: chat-qwen-prod: 429 storm and p99 latency spike after deploy
data.summary: p99 latency 0.9s -> 21s and 31% HTTP 429 within 6 minutes of deploy d-4117. Engine restarts with CUDA OOM.
